### Medical ICE Score (ICANS Monitoring)

The Immune Effector Cell-Associated Encephalopathy (ICE) score is a 10-point scale used to evaluate neurotoxicity.[[1]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11822436/)[[2]](https://www.researchgate.net/figure/Schematic-overview-of-the-ICE-grading-system-The-ICE-score-is-a-10-point-assessment-tool_fig7_404360517)

### Scoring Components (Max 10 Points)

- **Orientation (4 points):** Year (1 pt), month (1 pt), city (1 pt), and hospital (1 pt).
- **Naming (3 points):** Ability to name three objects (e.g., clock, pen, button).
- **Following Commands (1 point):** Ability to follow a simple command (e.g., "show me two fingers").
- **Writing (1 point):** Ability to write a standard sentence (e.g., "Our national bird is the bald eagle").
- **Attention (1 point):** Ability to count backwards from 100 by tens (serial 10s).[[1]](https://www.mdcalc.com/calc/10635/immune-effector-cell-encephalopathy-ice-score)[[2]](https://www.cancernursingtoday.com/post/oncology-nursing-assessment-of-crs-and-icans-in-patients-with-multiple-myeloma)[[3]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11822436/)

### ICANS Grade Correlation

- **ICE Score 10 / Grade 0:** No impairment.
- **ICE Score 7–9 / Grade 1:** Mild impairment.
- **ICE Score 3–6 / Grade 2:** Moderate impairment.
- **ICE Score 0–2 / Grade 3:** Severe impairment (arousable).
- **ICE Score 0 / Grade 4:** Unarousable or unable to perform the ICE assessment.[[1]](https://www.eviq.org.au/getmedia/798b0931-796f-4d71-9438-383cbd324834/ID-3835-Immune-Effector-Cell-Associated-Neurotoxicity-Syndrome-ICANS-assessment-tool-v2.pdf.aspx?ext=.pdf)[[2]](https://www.theattcnetwork.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/Neurotoxicity-assessment-for-CAR-T-cell-therapy.pdf)[[3]](https://cardvasc.org/docs/tools/calculators/icans-astct-consensus-grading)
